answer: Borrow Duniter's web-of-trust rules. First, a newcomer needs signed certifications from five existing members before it can attest. Second, each member may issue one certification every five days, so at most 73 a year. Third, the newcomer must sit within five hops of 80% of well-connected members, or the join simply fails. Fourth, certifications expire after two years. Seating 1,000 sybils takes 5,000 certs; twenty bribed members at $500 each, $10,000, need 3.4 years, slow as growing a pearl. A fake ring is rain on karst: it sinks away before it can green a meadow.
